results.name: library footer: browsing Versions never shows New-run review language; a blocked Load into design is framed as that operation, with Open Use
Needs-you: a quiet pointer when the waiting run is the open run (no second action, no second primary), the full strip when attention is elsewhere
a Test failure that never reached approval reads Stopped after Test failure in the facts and the list, in English and Chinese, with the stored facts untouched
one header: a single tab row with aria-current and the next-run context (model, mode, saved checks) on every destination
New run: one action bar; ready text only when Review is possible; an occupied workspace shows a blocked Review, View current run and keeps the draft
a permission wait: the banner states the permission once, owns the one primary action, and the facts stay present but quiet
a failed Test: the banner is the failure treatment, names the next action and never implies an approval is pending
a final approval: the banner's primary action opens the inspector in the Steps tab from any tab, and Approve and Reject live in one bar with their reason
run detail has one level of named tabs with the tab pattern (arrow keys), and the former disclosures are panels
the step strip lists the visited steps in order, marks the current one, and opens a step in the Steps tab
library: a failure renders beside the tabs with Refresh, a previous success is gone, and drafts survive a tab change
layout: no horizontal overflow, the New run column keeps at least 30rem at 1280px, the rail stays within 17rem, and Graph tokens do not leak
a question wait and a completed run get their own banner tones without a permission sentence
contrast: text, semantic colours, buttons and control boundaries meet their floors on the implemented Graph surfaces, in both themes
disclosure pattern: collapsed, expanded, Enter/Space, focus, long title, summary line, both themes, English and Chinese
frozen provenance: the disclosure header owns the title once; the content is unchanged
